title.en: Crushed stone illustrates the note on Electric 60 Prints the Fine-Stone Height
title.zh: 「碎石子」用来说明电动60怎样印出细石高度

description.en: Electric 60 Prints the Fine-Stone Height. 200 m stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Crushed stone.
description.zh: 电动60怎样印出细石高度。200 m仍在目录格子里。插图来自「碎石子」。

h1.en: Crushed stone illustrates the note on Electric 60 Prints the Fine-Stone Height
h1.zh: 「碎石子」用来说明电动60怎样印出细石高度

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 concrete pump fine-stone line in Xingtai as 200 m / 600 m under a horizontal / vertical label. Horizontal on that row is 200 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60混凝土泵的细石行写成水平/垂直标题下的 200 m / 600 m。同一页的 13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone. The image subject is Crushed stone. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 60 concrete pump fine-stone line in Xingtai as 200 m / 600 m under a horizontal / vertical label. The 600 m figure is not the height for every stone size, and it is not Electric 80's vertical entry. Hebei Pinjin Machinery also lists a 0.7 m³ hopper on this concrete pump, which is volume, not height. Using 600 m with 24 mm stone would ignore the row that actually lists 100 m / 300 m.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone。画面内容是Crushed stone。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60混凝土泵的细石行写成水平/垂直标题下的 200 m / 600 m。河北品锦机械还在这台混凝土泵上标出了 0.7 m³ 料斗，那是容积，不是高度。电动80标出 900 m / 300 m，所以它的水平是 900 m，垂直是 300 m。

body.en: Horizontal on that row is 200 m. Electric 60 lists 90 kW, 40 m³/h and 35 MPa as well. 13 mm stone is 150 m / 450 m. Electric 80 lists 900 m / 300 m, so its horizontal is 900 m and its vertical is 300 m.
body.zh: 同一页的 13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m，24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。13 mm 石子是 150 m / 450 m。

body.en: Vertical on that row is 600 m. None of those entries is a height. 24 mm stone is 100 m / 300 m. That vertical is not 600 m.
body.zh: 600 m 不是每种石子的高度，也不是电动80的垂直格。24 mm 石子是 100 m / 300 m。

body.en: The same page lists 13 mm stone at 150 m / 450 m and 24 mm stone at 100 m / 300 m. The 600 m sits in the second position of the fine-stone pair. Both keep horizontal first. Keep the concrete pump page you opened.
body.zh: 电动60还标出 90 kW、40 m³/h 和 35 MPa。把 600 m 用在 24 mm 石子上，等于无视实际标出着 100 m / 300 m 的那一行。

question.en: On this row: Is 600 m the horizontal distance?

answer.en: No. On the Electric 60 fine-stone label it is the vertical figure. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone.
answer.zh: 不是。在电动60细石标题下它是垂直数字。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What height applies to 24 mm stone?
question.zh: 24 mm 石子对应的高度是多少？

answer.en: The 24 mm row lists 100 m / 300 m, so the vertical figure on that row is 300 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone.
answer.zh: 24 mm 行标出的是 100 m / 300 m，所以这一行的垂直数字是 300 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone画面里印出的数字。

question.zh: 电动80也标出 600 m 吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 80 lists 900 m / 300 m. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone.
answer.zh: 没有。电动80标出 900 m / 300 m。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What motor is on this page?

answer.en: 90 kW. Output is 40 m³/h and outlet pressure is 35 MPa. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone.
answer.zh: 90 kW。产量 40 m³/h，出口压力 35 MPa。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Crushed_stone画面里印出的数字。
